name: Two-Stage Geodetic Strain-Budget Deficit Coarse Prior + Fine-Scale Ridge Detection
layers: Stage 1: geod_2ndinv, geod_shearrate, geod_dilaterate + GDR QFaults slip rates. Stage 2: LiDAR scarp features (ex_max, step_max, coh100), comp_det_elev_slope, comp_tmi_vg, comp_iso_grav_anom_slope.
signature: Stage 1 computes regional strain deficit via Kostrov (1974) moment-tensor summation (Kreemer et al. 2000 Eq. 3; Ward 1998; UCERF3 Field et al. 2014) across 10 km tiles. Stage 2 extracts high-curvature topographic scarps and geophysical linear discontinuities with 2.4 px steerable NMS and 200 m catalogue flank exclusion inside approved tiles.
why_new_faults: Where satellite geodetic strain rate exceeds what the mapped catalogue faults can accommodate, tectonic deformation dictates that uncatalogued or blind active structures MUST accommodate the residual strain budget. Fine-scale lineaments inside these high-deficit zones isolate the exact missing structures while avoiding false positives.
differs_from: Unlike previous empirical pruning or broad habitat statements, this explicitly couples a rigorous 3D Kostrov moment-tensor geodetic budget coarse prior with a fine-scale steerable ridge detector with 200 m catalogue flank exclusion and 2.4 px NMS spacing.
expected_dti: Rank 1; expected DTI 0.282 - 0.285+; highest expected win by balancing tectonic strain physics with metric distance credit.
cost: Low-to-Medium; fully supported by existing hash-verified competition rasters and GDR QFaults slip-rate data.
external_data_needed: None beyond hash-pinned competition feature layers and GDR QFaults CSV (already fetched and verified).
outcome: VALIDATED & PROMOTED: Stage 1 holdout Spearman 0.448; Stage 2 mean proxy DTI 0.2826 - 0.2836; uniqueness verified against all 21 cross-family references (Jaccard 0.0351 < 0.50, Containment 0.1678 < 0.60); Stage 1 lift = 0.890 < 1.5; fully compliant GeoTIFF generated.

name: Geothermal Permeability Relay Ramp & Stepover Strain-Coupling
signature: Cross-gradient maximum curvature and conductivity step along structural transfer zones between en-echelon normal fault segments.
why_new_faults: Mapped catalogue faults frequently terminate in regional databases without mapping the connecting relay ramps or cross-fault transfer zones. Hydrothermal fluids prefer breached relay zones and fault intersections (Faulds et al. 2011, 2015).
differs_from: Uses multi-scale structural tensor on potential field horizontal gradients coupled to basement stepover geometry, rather than raw single-band thresholding or broad habitat masks.

name: Potential Field Boundary Analytic Signal & Tilt Depth-Edge Coincidence
signature: Colocated local maxima of horizontal gradient and vertical zero-crossings (Blakely & Simpson 1986 boundary detection; Miller & Singh 1994 tilt depth-edge indicator).
why_new_faults: Unmapped faults in the Basin and Range are frequently concealed beneath Quaternary alluvium or basin fill (blind faults) where surface scarps have been eroded or buried, but density and magnetic contrasts across the basement fault interface persist.
differs_from: Employs true potential-field boundary tracking (tilt curvature and analytic signal crests) to discover buried basement faults invisible in surface DEMs.
cost: Medium; uses existing potential field bands.

name: Hydrothermal Alteration and Radiometric Potassium/Thorium Depletion Corridors
layers: rad_raw.dat (K, Th, U bands from GeoDAWN), comp_cond_surf, comp_det_elev_slope.
signature: Anomalous potassium enrichment (adularia/illite alteration) or thorium/potassium ratio anomalies along linear topographic steps with high shallow conductivity.
why_new_faults: Upwelling geothermal fluids alter wall-rock minerals along active fault conduits, leaving radiometric and electrical resistivity signatures even where displacement is small or concealed.
differs_from: Focuses on geochemical/mineral alteration signatures rather than purely tectonic topography.
cost: Medium; radiometric data has partial spatial gaps.
external_data_needed: GeoDAWN radiometric rasters (already restored in data/prepared/rad_raw.dat).
